action.text: The detect.restored_class criterion fails on all 12 pickle targets (2 policies × 6 protocols). Shallow copy and deep copy already use assertIs(type(eN), ...) correctly. The pickle loop uses assertIsInstance(e4, ...) which accepts subclasses. Fix: change to assertIs(type(e4), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) in the pickle loop of _assert_error_transport. File: Lib/test/test_configparser.py lines 2282-2283.
